name: Context Inject
description: Adds Context reactions to inject raw HTML/JS snippets and attach asset libraries to pages matched by a context.
project_description:
This module provides a context reactions to inject HTML snippets and libraries to page.

 Inject snippet usage 
 
 Create or edit any context 
 Add "Attach snippet" reaction 
 Put full HTML code inside textarea and choose placement position (page Top or Bottom) 
 
 Inject library usage 
 
 Create or edit any context 
 Add "Attach library" reaction 
 Put comma separated list of full library names prefixed with theme or module 
 Back to top
